claims.proves: The public Tau workflow command can prove rung 1 from a temporary clean checkout and retain verifier/negative receipts.
claims.does_not_prove: Rungs 2 through 5, provider semantic quality, or human acceptance of the full GOAL.md outcome.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Rung 1 of the canonical Tau DAG ladder runs from a clean checkout and fails closed under proof mutation.

cases.name: ladder-manifest-contract-tests
argv: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv run pytest --tau-suite=all -q tests/test_workflow_catalog.py tests/test_workflow_cli.py

cases.name: rung1-clean-checkout-live-proof
argv:
set -euo pipefail
# e2e clean-checkout proof through the public Tau workflow entrypoint.
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
TMP="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tau-issue-331-agentic-source"
rm -rf "$TMP"
git clone --no-local "$ROOT" "$TMP" >/dev/null
cd "$TMP"
uv run tau workflows prove-rung1-clean-checkout --source-repo "$TMP" --output-dir "$ROOT/docs/proofs/acceptance/issue-331-rung-1-clean-checkout"

cases.name: rung1-proof-negative-receipt-is-retained
argv:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('docs/proofs/acceptance/issue-331-rung-1-clean-checkout')
verifier = json.loads((root / 'verifier-pass-receipt.json').read_text())
negative = json.loads((root / 'negative-mutation-receipt.json').read_text())
assert verifier['status'] == 'PASS'
assert negative['status'] == 'PASS'
assert 'missing_required_artifact:rung-1-run/events.jsonl' in negative['verifier_errors']
print('{"status": "PASS", "checked": "negative-mutation-receipt"}')
PY
